title: NCAA: EAC spoils Manalili’s return with crucial win vs. Letran
summary: Emilio Aguinaldo College spoiled Titing Manalili’s return to action on Thursday, taking a 78-71 win over Letran in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament at the San Juan Arena.
